title: [main] Bug 656535 Additional Reporting Currency Difference After Closing Income Statement - related to 625803
summary: Close Income Statement now passes the closed additional reporting currency (ACY) amount through a new manually bound codeunit, not through Source Currency Amount. Before this, posting recalculated ACY from LCY at the closing-date rate, which left an ACY difference after closing.
key_points: Before the fix, the ACY amount was put in Source Currency Amount and ignored because the source currency code no longer matched the ACY
A new manually bound codeunit subscribes to OnGLCalcAddCurrencyPostingNone and supplies the ACY amount
Source Currency Amount now holds only real source currency values, and the 625803 behaviour stays the same
The retained-earnings balance line also passes its ACY total through the handler
New tests were added in the W1, BE, CZ, DE, ES and IT layers
quote: The ACY amount is supplied on its own.
